# ReadmeDemo

> An experimental nuget feed demo package.

## Install

```
<PackageReference Include="ReadmeDemo" Version="1.2.3" />
```

## Features

- daily download and page view chart
- readme rendered on the package detail page
- TOTP protected publishing through xGet

| field | value |
| --- | --- |
| feed | xDoc |
| protocol | NuGet v3 |
